cohort.warm_selected_memory: per original role and family only, three DEV seeds; each new source env reset starts new episode; no memory exchange or sealed holdout; all seeds exposed on original selected action

mechanism.type: hand-engineered public source-selected one-step empirical transition surprise / contextual action-value, not proven spatial localization or discovered semantics
mechanism.parent: exact untouched DoorMemoryNavigation MG47 source selected-action scorer, unchanged MG44 public release target FSM; both new arms inherit the same object-semantic handcoded affordance and all selected-source feedback
mechanism.context: strict SHA256 of own original public before 7x7x3 image+public direction+literal mission; previous own action0-6 predicts after public SHA256, only own selected before/action/after
mechanism.experience: for each contextual own selected action maintain n and number unchanged source public observations. Count distinct observed after hashes. For memory bound cap 2048 distinct (public-context/action) keys per family, ignore new evidence after limit but retain existing counts
mechanism.predictor: Laplace-smoothed probability of changed public view per action: (changed+1)/(count+2) -- this is prediction of original public observation change, NOT goal reward or physical movement
mechanism.choice: only phase seek and no public exact target directly ahead, candidate source chooses original MG47 action first then, IF its exact public context has >=2 prior own-selected transitions of any action, favor among 0(left),1(right),2(forward) the action with highest predictor of source-public change, with tie prefer original if among options otherwise smallest action, subject to public front wall/closed-door blocking forward; only override if predicted change for alternative > original action predicted change by at least 1/4. No override of door action5, pickup3, drop4, or MG44 release phase, nor mission-target directly ahead. Predictions uncertain source context only; no hidden maps, poses, inventories
mechanism.same_model_ablation: identical own selected context/action prediction records and checkpoint, no policy override when enabled=false. This should exactly reproduce unchanged original MG47 same-seed action selections if replay roles align.
mechanism.features: engineered original public data/hash and known 7 MiniGrid actions are not learned; public-view change is not movement, progress, causal novelty or true route discovery

measures.primary: actual original positive terminal goals and first exact public target sightings on larger KeyCorridor DEV plus positive ObstructedMaze goals
measures.secondary: own source-selected actions, predictor decisions/overrides, visits to public contexts, observed source public change, exact goal pickup/drop effects and real door openings
measures.resource: original source-selected action cap equal; auxiliary outer wall/Python CPU and child CPU per role; no native CPU/RSS/energy parity

all: >=1 authentic original exact mission-target public frame in a larger KeyCorridor
candidate >=1 original goal-positive terminal episode in a larger KeyCorridor
candidate >=1 original goal-positive terminal episode in ObstructedMaze
candidate total authentic positive goals strictly greater than each frozen comparator including same-model ablation
candidate >=1 own-selected contextually grounded policy override based on >=2 prior source-selected transitions
dual OS source-only PASS before new original source actions and two identical complete source processes
